query:
SELECT 
  c.id, c.claim_number, c.status, c.created_at, c.incident_date,
  aa.id as assessment_id, aa.fraud_risk_level, aa.confidence_score,
  aa.created_at as assessment_created,
  LEFT(aa.error_message, 200) as error_msg
FROM claims c
LEFT JOIN ai_assessments aa ON aa.claim_id = c.id
WHERE c.id = 570375
ORDER BY aa.created_at DESC
LIMIT 3;
